title: Extraction manifest
description: Allowlist manifest for tools/repo/extract/extract.py. Only the files listed under files ever leave the source tree. The tool validates every rule here and more (each regex compiles, each from exists, SKILL.md targets convert their frontmatter); see tools/repo/extract/README.md.

$schema.description: Optional path to this schema, so editors can validate the manifest. The tool ignores it.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Always the string "1".

description.description: Free text for the people reading the manifest.

defaults.description: Applies to every entry that doesn't set its own value.

rewrites.description: Rule sets for entries without their own rewrites list. When omitted: every rule set except frontmatter.

persona_map.description: Persona display name -> functional role id. Matched case-sensitively as a whole word. A persona name left in the output (for example inside an identifier) is flagged.

owner_terms.description: Owner name, nickname or address -> neutral replacement, usually "the owner". Matched as a whole word, longest term first. The exact case and the ALL-CAPS form are rewritten (capitalized at a sentence start); any other case variant is flagged. Every term must also be caught by the leak gate, or the run fails closed.

path_map.description: Path prefix -> replacement prefix. A key starting with ~/ matches any home directory: a macOS or Linux home path, ~/, $HOME/ or ${HOME}/. Absolute and home keys apply first, then relative keys; the longest key wins. Any home-directory path left afterwards is flagged.

rewrite_patterns.description: Safe regular-expression rewrites, applied in order to each line. Use them only where the result is always right; anything that needs judgment belongs in flag_patterns.

drop_patterns.description: Lines or blocks removed from every entry that applies drop_patterns.

flag_patterns.description: Text no rule can rewrite safely, such as model names, mythic framing and client names. Any match left in the output is a flag, and every flag blocks the run.

never_export.description: Gitignore-style globs, matched case-insensitively against each entry's from. A match is a manifest error. A pattern without a slash matches a name at any depth.

frontmatter.description: How the frontmatter rewrite converts old skill frontmatter to the portable Agent Skills format.

drop_keys.description: Old keys to drop instead of moving them under metadata.

rename_keys.description: Old key -> new key, applied before keys are lowercased and underscores become hyphens.

list_separator.description: Joins list values into one metadata string. Default ", ".

roles.description: Role frontmatter (adapters/ROLES.md) for each engine/roles/<id>/soul.md target. The tool writes the block; the source file must not carry one.

tier.description: A capability tier, never a model name.

plugins.description: Plugin folders to generate .claude-plugin/plugin.json and README.md for. Each needs at least one skill under <folder>/skills/.

files.description: The allowlist. Each entry copies one source file to one target path.

rewrites.description: Rule sets to apply. They always run in this order: drop_patterns, rewrite_patterns, path_map, owner_terms, persona_map, then frontmatter.

term.description: Non-empty, single line, no leading or trailing whitespace.

roleId.description: A functional role id in kebab-case, such as owner-auditor.

ruleId.description: Lowercase id shown in the report.

regex.description: Python regular expression, applied to one line at a time. Inline flags such as (?i) go first. It must not match an empty string.

relPath.description: Relative POSIX path: no leading slash, no backslash, no drive letter, no . or .. segments, no empty segments.

replace.description: Python replacement template; \1 and \g<name> refer to groups. It must not insert line breaks.

start.description: Drop a block starting at the first line this matches.

end.description: The block ends at, and includes, the next line this matches. If none does, that is a flag.

before.description: The block ends just before the next line this matches, or at the end of the file.

id.description: Must not reuse an id the tool raises itself.

description.description: Shown in the report next to each match.

replaceRule.description: Entry-scoped replacement, written after reading the report. It runs before every other in-line rule, on the source text.

find.description: Exact text, or a Python regex when regex is true. Single line.

with.description: Replacement text, or a template when regex is true. Single line.

regex.description: Treat find as a regular expression. Default false.

select.description: Export only one block of the source, for example one section of a long file.

from.description: Source file, relative to --source, in exact letter case.

to.description: Target path inside --out. Unique, ignoring letter case. Never under internal/ or .git. A .../<skill>/SKILL.md target must apply the frontmatter rewrite.

binary.description: Copy the bytes verbatim, with no rewrites or flag checks. The leak gate still scans the file.

note.description: Shown in the report under the file.
